claims.claim: Recognizes period, exclamation, and question marker token forms.
Maps marker text to edit, ask, or context actions.
Parses markers into records carrying action, comment block, instruction, context inputs, source line, and path.
Queues watched file batches through the watcher router with configured prompt context limits.
Treats context markers as non-actionable and filters them from turn dispatch.
Dispatches a filtered marker batch by building a prompt and sending it as a user message.
Watches debounced file changes without following symbolic links.
Rejects cleanup paths whose lexical resolution leaves the current working directory.
Requires cleanup targets to be non-symlink files whose canonical paths remain inside the canonical current working directory before reads and writes.
Runs configured cleanup for completed batch files through lexical resolution, guarded reads, parsing, and guarded writes.
Runs marker cleanup after the triggered turn settles.
